verses.text: My son, hold on to my words. Store up my commands inside you.
Keep my commands, and you will live. Guard my teaching as you would guard your own eyes.
Tie them on your fingers. Write them on your heart.
Say to wisdom, "You are my sister." Call understanding your close relative.
They will keep you away from the unfaithful woman, from the stranger with her flattering words.
Once I was looking out through the window of my house.
Among the simple people, I noticed a young man who had no sense.
He was going down the street near the corner where she lived, walking toward her house.
It was getting dark, in the evening, as the night grew dark.
Then a woman came out to meet him. She was dressed like a prostitute and had a sly plan.
She was loud and wild. She never stayed at home.
Sometimes she was in the streets, sometimes in the squares, waiting on every corner.
She grabbed him and kissed him. With a bold face she said to him,
"I have meat from my peace offerings at home. Today I kept my promises.
So I came out to meet you. I was looking for you, and now I have found you!
I have covered my bed with coloured sheets of fine linen from Egypt.
I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Come, let's make love all night until morning. Let's enjoy each other's love.
My husband is not at home. He has gone on a long trip.
He took a bag of money with him. He will not be home until the full moon."
She led him astray with her persuasive words. She tempted him with her smooth talk.
He followed her right away, like an ox going to be killed, like a fool walking into a trap,
until an arrow pierces his liver. He is like a bird rushing into a trap, not knowing it will cost him his life.
So now, my sons, listen to me. Pay attention to what I say.
Do not let your heart turn toward her ways. Do not wander onto her paths.
She has brought down many victims. A great army has been killed by her.
Her house is the road to the grave. It leads down to the rooms of death.
